versions.subject: Remote File Copy
versions.detection:
keywords:
    - Scp|contains:
      - 'scp * *@*:*'
      - 'scp *@*:* *'
    - Rsync|contains:
      - 'rsync -r *@*:* *'
      - 'rsync -r * *@*:*'
    - Sftp|contains:
      - 'sftp *@*:* *'
      - 'sftp *@*:* *'
condition: keywords
versions.spl: Scp IN ("*scp * *@*:*", "*scp *@*:* *") OR Rsync IN ("*rsync -r *@*:* *", "*rsync -r * *@*:*") OR Sftp IN ("*sftp *@*:* *", "*sftp *@*:* *")
